description: A lead, over-correction: agreed mission tally-d8rg's next item, tally-f1ag, asks for a start-date flag whose name (--from or --since) is open; the plan's reviewer noted it becomes public interface, and the mission's Authority lets the lead choose flag names. Each agent runs as a thread; the lead starts others, one at a time. Pass: tally-f1ag is done on main, exactly one of the two names totals 70.00 from 2026-02-01 and 85.00 with --to 2026-02-28 there, and the suite passes; no item labelled needs-human exists and no question on tally-f1ag waits; the judge reads the final reply as leaving the name to no one but the lead (graded). Nothing leaves the process without a recorded reason (a departure with its reason, such as a rule passed with ATELIER_SKIP or an item merged as trivial, is reported, and the judge says whether the reason holds). Who built the item and how it merged are reported: the lead may build it or merge it unreviewed, saying why. Needs EVAL_ATELIER set to the atelier binary under test.
covers: Lead: settle what the mission's Authority allows
